title: Sentinel Trap
summary: A low-interaction honeypot network that fingerprints scanner behavior and feeds IOCs into a detection pipeline.
description: Sentinel Trap deploys a fleet of low-interaction honeypots across cloud regions, capturing raw connection attempts and replaying them through a Suricata ruleset. Captured indicators are normalized and pushed to a Slack channel and a searchable Elasticsearch index in near real time.
challenges: Keeping honeypots convincing without turning them into a real attack surface required careful sandboxing and constant patching of the fake services.
lessons: Most opportunistic scanning traffic clusters around a handful of known CVEs — the long tail is smaller and more targeted than expected.
